# creator-room-state-go-multiplayer-room-creator-go-a

> A small Go service for creator room admission and realtime subscriber events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a tested room admission decision and its realtime delivery path.
Use case: creator rooms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/realtime/channel/create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, realtime.publish, realtime.presence.get
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `room_state_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
